title: Resolution urging Albany to simplify income checks for property tax breaks
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to create a centralized system verifying income for homeowner property tax exemptions, such as the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption and Disabled Homeowners' Exemption. It would let the city's Department of Finance use state income data instead of requiring homeowners to repeatedly submit financial documents. The measure is modeled on the state's existing Enhanced STAR Income Verification Program.
